local function buildMetadataTable(): { any }
	-- Send a dense list so despawned IDs cannot create holes in the remote payload.
	local meta: { any } = {}
	for netId, h in pairs(ActiveHeroesByNetId) do
		table.insert(meta, {
			NetId = netId,
			IsHero = true,
			OwnerUserId = h.Owner.UserId,
			OwnerName = h.Owner.DisplayName,
			HeroUUID = h.HeroUUID,
			TemplateId = h.TemplateId,
			Name = h.DisplayName,
			Stars = h.Stars,
			Level = h.Level,
			SlotIndex = h.SlotIndex,
			MaxHP = h.MaxHP,
			EquippedArtifactId = h.EquippedArtifactId,
			EquippedArtifactRarity = h.EquippedArtifactRarity,
			EquippedArtifactType = h.EquippedArtifactType,
			EquippedArtifactStar = h.EquippedArtifactStar,
		})
	end
	for netId, m in pairs(ActiveMobsByNetId) do
		if m.IsAlive then
			table.insert(meta, {
				NetId = netId,
				IsHero = false,
				SpecId = m.SpecId,
				MobType = m.MobType,
				Name = m.DisplayName,
				RingIndex = m.RingIndex,
				GroundY = m.HomePosition.Y,
				MaxHP = m.MaxHP,
				Phase = m.Phase,
			})
		end
	end
	return meta
end

local function broadcastMetadata(targetPlayer: Player?)
	local payload = buildMetadataTable()
	if targetPlayer then
		EntityMetadataRemote:FireClient(targetPlayer, payload)
	else
		EntityMetadataRemote:FireAllClients(payload)
	end
end

local LastMetadataRequestByPlayer: { [Player]: number } = {}
EntityMetadataRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local lastRequest = LastMetadataRequestByPlayer[player]
	if lastRequest and now - lastRequest < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	LastMetadataRequestByPlayer[player] = now
	broadcastMetadata(player)
end)

local function getHorizontalDistance(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	local dx = a.X - b.X
	local dz = a.Z - b.Z
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
end

local function getGroundHeightForRadius(r: number): number
	if r <= 122 then
		return 16.0
	elseif r <= 282 then
		return 4.0
	elseif r <= 462 then
		return 2.0
	end
	return 12.0
end

local function getZoneStaminaDrainPerSec(pos: Vector3): number
	local r = math.sqrt(pos.X * pos.X + pos.Z * pos.Z)
	if r <= 122 then
		return 1.50 -- Ring 3
	elseif r <= 282 then
		return 1.20 -- Ring 2
	elseif r <= 462 then
		return 0.80 -- Ring 1
	end
	return 0.0 -- Safe Zone / Waiting Room Plot
end

local function getFormationOffset(slotIndex: number): Vector3
	local angle = ((slotIndex - 1) / 5) * (math.pi * 2)
	return Vector3.new(
		math.cos(angle) * MASTER_FORMATION_RADIUS,
		0,
		math.sin(angle) * MASTER_FORMATION_RADIUS
	)
end

local function getMasterRootPosition(player: Player): Vector3?
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return nil
	end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

-- Refresh progression without rebuilding entities, resetting cooldowns, or healing.
-- Facility output reads StatFormulas from profile data on its existing 1 Hz loop.
function CombatSimulation.RefreshPlayerHeroStats(player: Player)
	local state = ActiveMasters[player]
	local profile = getDataManager().GetProfile(player)
	if not state or not profile then return end
	local metadataChanged = false
	for uuid, simHero in pairs(state.DeployedHeroes) do
		local hero = profile.Heroes[uuid]
		if hero then
			local atk, hp = StatFormulas.GetEffectiveCombatStats(hero, false, false)
			metadataChanged = metadataChanged or simHero.Level ~= hero.Level or simHero.Stars ~= hero.Stars or simHero.MaxHP ~= hp
			simHero.Level, simHero.Stars = hero.Level, hero.Stars
			simHero.EffectiveATK, simHero.MaxHP = atk, hp
			simHero.CurrentHP = math.min(simHero.CurrentHP, hp)
		end
	end
	if metadataChanged then broadcastMetadata(nil) end
end

function CombatSimulation.RebuildPlayerSquad(player: Player)
	local dm = getDataManager()
	local profile = dm.GetProfile(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end

	local masterState = ActiveMasters[player]
	if not masterState then
		masterState = {
			FocusedTargetNetId = nil,
			LastOverdriveClock = -99,
			LastRecallClock = -99,
			DeployedHeroes = {},
			CarriedLoot = { Gold = 0, Gems = 0 },
			CanCollectLoot = true,
			IsSquadWiped = false,
		}
		ActiveMasters[player] = masterState
	end

	local masterPos = getMasterRootPosition(player) or Vector3.new(0, 14, -510)
		local desiredUUIDs: { [string]: number } = {}

	for slot = 1, 5 do
		local slotTag = "SQUAD_SLOT_" .. tostring(slot)
		for uuid, heroData in pairs(profile.Heroes) do
			if heroData.Assignment == slotTag and (heroData.ComaUntilTimestamp or 0) <= os.time() then
				desiredUUIDs[uuid] = slot
				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- Remove heroes no longer deployed
	for uuid, simHero in pairs(masterState.DeployedHeroes) do
		if not desiredUUIDs[uuid] then
			HeroNavigation.Clear(simHero)
			ProgressionAwards[simHero.NetId] = nil
			ActiveHeroesByNetId[simHero.NetId] = nil
			masterState.DeployedHeroes[uuid] = nil
		end
	end

	-- Add or update deployed heroes
	for uuid, slotIndex in pairs(desiredUUIDs) do
		local heroData = profile.Heroes[uuid]
		local artifact = heroData.EquippedArtifactUUID and profile.Artifacts and profile.Artifacts[heroData.EquippedArtifactUUID]
		local effATK, effHP, _, effInterval = StatFormulas.GetEffectiveCombatStats(heroData, false, false, artifact)
		local existing = masterState.DeployedHeroes[uuid]
		if existing then
			existing.Stars = heroData.Stars
			existing.Level = heroData.Level
			existing.EffectiveATK = effATK
			existing.MaxHP = effHP
			existing.CurrentHP = math.min(existing.CurrentHP, effHP)
			existing.Stamina = heroData.CurrentStamina
			existing.SlotIndex = slotIndex
			existing.AttackInterval = effInterval
			existing.EquippedArtifactId = artifact and artifact.TemplateId
			existing.EquippedArtifactRarity = artifact and artifact.Rarity
			existing.EquippedArtifactType = artifact and artifact.Type
			existing.EquippedArtifactStar = artifact and artifact.Star
		else
			local netId = allocateNetId()
			local spawnPos = HeroNavigation.PlaceNear(masterPos, getFormationOffset(slotIndex))
			local newSim: SimHero = {
				NetId = netId,
				Owner = player,
				HeroUUID = uuid,
				TemplateId = heroData.TemplateId,
				DisplayName = heroData.DisplayName,
				Stars = heroData.Stars,
				Level = heroData.Level,
				State = "FOLLOW_MASTER",
				Position = spawnPos,
				Yaw = 0,
				CurrentHP = effHP,
				MaxHP = effHP,
				EffectiveATK = effATK,
				AttackRange = heroData.AttackRange or 6,
				AttackInterval = effInterval,
				MoveSpeed = 20.0,
				Stamina = heroData.CurrentStamina or 100.0,
				SlotIndex = slotIndex,
				TargetNetId = masterState.FocusedTargetNetId,
				AttackCooldown = 0.2,
				PacifiedUntil = 0,
				OverdriveUntil = 0,
				EquippedArtifactId = artifact and artifact.TemplateId,
				EquippedArtifactRarity = artifact and artifact.Rarity,
				EquippedArtifactType = artifact and artifact.Type,
				EquippedArtifactStar = artifact and artifact.Star,
			}
			masterState.DeployedHeroes[uuid] = newSim
			ActiveHeroesByNetId[netId] = newSim
		end
	end

	if masterState.IsSquadWiped then
		local hasAliveHero = false
		for _, h in pairs(masterState.DeployedHeroes) do
			if h.State ~= "COMA" and h.CurrentHP > 0 then
				hasAliveHero = true
				break
			end
		end
		if hasAliveHero then
			masterState.IsSquadWiped = false
			masterState.CanCollectLoot = true
			if player.Character then
				player.Character:SetAttribute("SquadWiped", false)
			end
			SquadWipeStateRemote:FireClient(player, false)
			dm.SendToast(player, "🛡️ Squad operational! Field looting re-enabled.", "SUCCESS")
		end
	end

	broadcastMetadata(nil)
end

local function clearLootCarryState(player: Player)
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		char:SetAttribute("CarryingLoot", false)
		char:SetAttribute("CarryingLootType", nil)
		char:SetAttribute("CarryingLootAmount", nil)
		char:SetAttribute("CarryingLootName", nil)
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 16.0 end
	end
	CarrierToHeldLoot[player] = nil
	CarriedLootSyncRemote:FireClient(player, 0, 0)
end

function CombatSimulation.DropCarriedLoot(player: Player, openLoot: boolean?): boolean
	local held = CarrierToHeldLoot[player]
	if not held then return false end
	if held.Weld then held.Weld:Destroy() end

	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local part = held.Part
	clearLootCarryState(player)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return true end

	local position = root and (root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 8) or part.Position
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char or part, PhysicalLootFolder, Workspace.PhysicalRelics}
	local ground = Workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Vector3.new(0, -64, 0), params)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Position = ground and (ground.Position + Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 0.2, 0)) or position
	part.Parent = PhysicalLootFolder

	local now = os.clock()
	local dropped = {
		LootId = held.LootId, LootType = held.LootType, Amount = held.Amount,
		Part = part, Prompt = held.OriginalPrompt, Billboard = held.Billboard,
		KillerUserId = openLoot and 0 or held.KillerUserId,
		KillerName = openLoot and "Open" or held.KillerName,
		SpawnTime = now, DespawnTime = now + 90,
		PickupBlockedUserId = player.UserId, PickupBlockedUntil = now + 1.5,
	}
	ActiveLootDrops[held.LootId] = dropped
	if held.OriginalPrompt then
		held.OriginalPrompt.ActionText = "Hold / Carry"
		held.OriginalPrompt.Enabled = true
	end
	task.delay(90, function()
		if ActiveLootDrops[held.LootId] == dropped then
			ActiveLootDrops[held.LootId] = nil
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	return true
end

local function knockHeroIntoComa(simHero: SimHero, baseComaSeconds: number)
	HeroNavigation.Clear(simHero)
	local dm = getDataManager()
	local profile = dm.GetProfile(simHero.Owner)
	local effectiveComa = baseComaSeconds

	if profile then
		local inf = profile.Facilities.Infirmary
		local sumLabor = 0
		for _, wUUID in ipairs(inf.AssignedHeroUUIDs) do
			local wHero = profile.Heroes[wUUID]
			if wHero then
				sumLabor += StatFormulas.GetEffectiveLabor(wHero, "FACILITY_INFIRMARY")
			end
		end
		local _, reducedComa = StatFormulas.GetInfirmaryRates(inf.Level, sumLabor)
		effectiveComa = math.round(reducedComa)

		local heroInstance = profile.Heroes[simHero.HeroUUID]
		if heroInstance then
			heroInstance.CurrentStamina = 0
			heroInstance.ComaUntilTimestamp = os.time() + effectiveComa
			heroInstance.Assignment = "FACILITY_INFIRMARY"
		end
	end

	ProgressionAwards[simHero.NetId] = nil
	ActiveHeroesByNetId[simHero.NetId] = nil
	local masterState = ActiveMasters[simHero.Owner]
	if masterState then
		masterState.DeployedHeroes[simHero.HeroUUID] = nil
	end

	dm.SendToast(
		simHero.Owner,
		string.format("🚑 %s entered a %ds COMA and was warped to your Infirmary!", simHero.DisplayName, effectiveComa),
		"WARN"
	)
	dm.SyncProfile(simHero.Owner)

	-- Squad Wipe Detection: Check if ALL deployed heroes are now in Coma
	local hasAliveHero = false
	if masterState then
		for _, h in pairs(masterState.DeployedHeroes) do
			if h.State ~= "COMA" and h.CurrentHP > 0 then
				hasAliveHero = true
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if not hasAliveHero and masterState and not masterState.IsSquadWiped then
		masterState.CanCollectLoot = false
		masterState.IsSquadWiped = true
		if simHero.Owner.Character then
			simHero.Owner.Character:SetAttribute("SquadWiped", true)
		end

		CombatSimulation.DropCarriedLoot(simHero.Owner, true)

		if _G.RelicService then
			_G.RelicService.FumbleRelicOnAoEHit(simHero.Owner)
		end

		masterState.CarriedLoot = { Gold = 0, Gems = 0 }
		CarriedLootSyncRemote:FireClient(simHero.Owner, 0, 0)
		SquadWipeStateRemote:FireClient(simHero.Owner, true)

		dm.SendToast(
			simHero.Owner,
			"💀 ALL HEROES FALLEN! All carried loot dropped! Return to your Waiting Room to recover your squad.",
			"WARN"
		)
	end

	broadcastMetadata(nil)
end

	local netId = allocateNetId()
	local now = os.clock()
	local mob: SimMob = {
		NetId = netId,
		SpecId = specId,
		DisplayName = spec and spec.Name or "Dimensional Entity",
		MobType = mobType,
		RingIndex = spec and spec.Ring or 1,
		Position = pos,
		HomePosition = pos,
		Yaw = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
		CurrentHP = spec and spec.MaxHP or 1000,
		MaxHP = spec and spec.MaxHP or 1000,
		ATK = spec and spec.ATK or 25,
		AttackInterval = spec and spec.AttackInterval or 1.5,
		AttackCooldown = 1.0,
		IsAlive = true,
		RespawnAt = 0,
		NextAoECastTime = (spec and spec.AoECooldown and spec.AoECooldown > 0) and (now + math.random(4, 10)) or 0,
		AoEDetonateTime = nil,
		AoERadius = spec and spec.AoERadius or 0,
		Phase = 1,
		NextNovaCastTime = now + NOVA_INTERVAL,
		NovaDetonateTime = nil,
		PunishWindowUntil = 0,
		DespawnAt = nil,
		DamageLedger = {},
	}
	ActiveMobsByNetId[netId] = mob
	return mob
end

function CombatSimulation.SpawnWorldBoss()
	if ActiveWorldBoss and ActiveWorldBoss.IsAlive then
		return
	end
	local dm = getDataManager()

	-- Dynamic HP Scaling Formula (Document 1 Section 5.1)

function collectPhysicalLoot(player: Player, lootId: number)
	local loot = ActiveLootDrops[lootId]
	if not loot or not loot.Part or not loot.Part.Parent then
		return
	end

	if loot.PickupBlockedUserId == player.UserId and os.clock() < (loot.PickupBlockedUntil or 0) then
		return
	end

	local masterState = ActiveMasters[player]
	if not masterState then
		return
	end

	local dm = getDataManager()

	-- 1. Check Squad Wipe / Looting Lockout
	if not masterState.CanCollectLoot or (player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("SquadWiped") == true) then
		dm.SendToast(player, "🚫 SQUAD DOWN! You cannot collect loot until you recover your squad at your Waiting Room!", "WARN")
		return
	end

	-- 2. Check if player is already holding loot
	if CarrierToHeldLoot[player] ~= nil or (player.Character and (player.Character:GetAttribute("CarryingLoot") == true or player.Character:GetAttribute("CarryingRelic") ~= nil)) then
		dm.SendToast(player, "⚠️ You are already carrying loot! Drop it with [R] or bank it at the Perimeter Highway or Plot first.", "WARN")
		return
	end

	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if (hrp.Position - loot.Part.Position).Magnitude > 12 then return end

	ActiveLootDrops[lootId] = nil
	local part = loot.Part
	local lootType = loot.LootType
	local amount = loot.Amount
	local killerUserId = loot.KillerUserId
	local killerName = loot.KillerName

	if loot.Prompt then
		loot.Prompt.Enabled = false
	end

	-- Physically Weld Overhead with Holding Pose
	part.Anchored = false
	part.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4.6, 0)

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = hrp
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.Parent = part

	-- Set Character Attributes to trigger Holding Animation & HUD banner
	char:SetAttribute("CarryingLoot", true)
	char:SetAttribute("CarryingLootType", lootType)
	char:SetAttribute("CarryingLootAmount", amount)
	char:SetAttribute("CarryingLootName", string.format("%d %s", amount, lootType))

	-- Movement penalty: -15% WalkSpeed while hauling cargo
	hum.WalkSpeed = 16.0 * 0.85

	CarrierToHeldLoot[player] = {
		LootId = lootId,
		Part = part,
		Weld = weld,
		LootType = lootType,
		Amount = amount,
		KillerUserId = killerUserId,
		KillerName = killerName,
		OriginalPrompt = loot.Prompt,
		Billboard = loot.Billboard,
	}

	local g = (lootType == "GOLD" and amount or 0)
	local gm = (lootType == "GEMS" and amount or 0)
	CarriedLootSyncRemote:FireClient(player, g, gm)

	CombatVFXRemote:FireAllClients("LOOT_PICKUP", hrp.Position)

	local isStolen = (killerUserId ~= 0 and killerUserId ~= player.UserId)
	if not isStolen then
		dm.SendToast(player, string.format("🎒 Holding %d %s (-15%% Spd)! Haul it to the Perimeter Highway to bank!", amount, lootType), "INFO")
	else
		TheftGrudges[killerUserId] = TheftGrudges[killerUserId] or {}
		TheftGrudges[killerUserId][player.UserId] = os.clock() + 180

		char:SetAttribute("IsLootThief", true)

		local victimPlayer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(killerUserId)
		if victimPlayer then
			dm.SendToast(victimPlayer, string.format("🚨 %s STOLE YOUR %d %s! Click them to retaliate!", player.DisplayName, amount, lootType), "WARN")
			LootStolenAlertRemote:FireClient(victimPlayer, player.UserId, player.DisplayName, lootType, amount)
		end

		dm.SendToast(player, string.format("⚠️ You stole %s's loot! Their squad can now attack you in retaliation!", killerName), "WARN")
	end
end

local function awardParticipationXP(mob: SimMob)
	local hits = ProgressionHits[mob.NetId]
	ProgressionHits[mob.NetId] = nil
	if not hits then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local cfg = PitBalance.CombatXP
	local amount = (mob.MobType == "WORLD_BOSS" or mob.MobType == "RIFT_BOSS") and cfg.Boss
		or (mob.RingIndex >= 2 and cfg.Ring2 or cfg.Ring1)
	-- Defer profile changes until the current death/tick finishes iterating entities.
	task.defer(function()
		local dm = getDataManager()
		if not dm.GrantCombatXP then return end
		for netId, contribution in pairs(hits) do
			local hero = ActiveHeroesByNetId[netId]
			local owner = hero and hero.Owner
			local character = owner and owner.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hero and owner and owner.Parent == Players and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
				and hero.State ~= "COMA" and hero.CurrentHP > 0 and hero.Stamina > 0
				and now - (ProgressionActivity[owner] or -math.huge) <= cfg.ActivityWindow
				and now - contribution.At <= cfg.ParticipationWindow
				and contribution.Damage >= mob.MaxHP * cfg.MinimumDamageFraction
				and now - (ProgressionAwards[netId] or -math.huge) >= cfg.AwardCooldown then
				ProgressionAwards[netId] = now
				dm.GrantCombatXP(owner, hero.HeroUUID, amount)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function handleMobDeath(mob: SimMob, killerPlayer: Player)
	local dm = getDataManager()
	mob.IsAlive = false
	awardParticipationXP(mob)

	if mob.MobType == "WORLD_BOSS" then
		ActiveWorldBoss = nil
		-- Compute Total Boss Damage & Shared Blood Pact Scores (Document 1 Section 5.4 & 6.1)
		local totalRawDamage = 0
		for _, dmg in pairs(mob.DamageLedger) do
			totalRawDamage += dmg
		end
		totalRawDamage = math.max(1, totalRawDamage)

		local rankedScores = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local raw = mob.DamageLedger[p.UserId] or 0
			local prof = dm.GetProfile(p)
			local combinedScore = raw
			local pct = (combinedScore / totalRawDamage) * 100.0
			table.insert(rankedScores, {
				Player = p,
				Profile = prof,
				Score = combinedScore,
				Pct = pct,
			})
		end

		table.sort(rankedScores, function(a, b)
			return a.Score > b.Score
		end)

		local rank1UserId = rankedScores[1] and rankedScores[1].Player.UserId or killerPlayer.UserId

		-- Part A: 50% Direct Payout + Boss Pity Meter
		for rankIdx, entry in ipairs(rankedScores) do
			if entry.Pct >= 3.0 and entry.Profile then
				local payout = WorldBossConfig.DirectPayoutByRank[math.min(6, rankIdx)]
				entry.Profile.Currencies.Gems += payout.Gems
				entry.Profile.Currencies.Gold += payout.Gold
				entry.Profile.BossPity = math.min(100, entry.Profile.BossPity + payout.PityGain)

				local wonArchon = (math.random() <= payout.ArchonChance) or (entry.Profile.BossPity >= 100)
				if wonArchon then
					entry.Profile.BossPity = 0
					local uuid, archon = dm.CreateHeroFromSeed("hero_archon", 1.12)
					entry.Profile.Heroes[uuid] = archon
					dm.BroadcastToast(string.format("👑 %s obtained the 3★ Boss Exclusive Hero: SOVEREIGN ARCHON!", entry.Player.DisplayName), "SUCCESS")
				end

				dm.SendToast(
					entry.Player,
					string.format(
						"🏆 World Boss Rank #%d (%.1f%% DMG): +%d Gems, +%d Gold (Boss Pity: %d%%)!",
						rankIdx, entry.Pct, payout.Gems, payout.Gold, entry.Profile.BossPity
					),
					"SUCCESS"
				)
				dm.SyncProfile(entry.Player)
			end
		end

		-- Part B: 50% Physical Drop — THE CALAMITY HEART (15s Rank #1 DPS Lock!)
		if _G.RelicService then
			_G.RelicService.SpawnRelic("CALAMITY_HEART", WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN, rank1UserId)
			dm.BroadcastToast(
				string.format("❤️‍🔥 THE CALAMITY HEART HAS DROPPED AT RING 3! (15s Exclusive Lock for Rank #1 DPS: %s)", rankedScores[1] and rankedScores[1].Player.DisplayName or killerPlayer.DisplayName),
				"WARN"
			)
		end

		broadcastMetadata(nil)
		return
	end

	-- Standard Mob / Elite / Rift Warden Death
	local spec = (WorldBossConfig.MobSpecs :: any)[mob.SpecId]
	if spec then
		-- Point 1: Universal Physical Loot Drops
		if spec.GoldReward and spec.GoldReward > 0 then
			spawnPhysicalLoot("GOLD", spec.GoldReward, mob.Position, killerPlayer)
		end

		if mob.SpecId == "mob_mana_node" then
			spawnPhysicalLoot("GEMS", math.random(15, 30), mob.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 0), killerPlayer)
		elseif mob.MobType == "RING2_ELITE" then
			spawnPhysicalLoot("GEMS", math.random(12, 25), mob.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 0), killerPlayer)
		end

		if _G.RelicService and spec.Drops then
			for tierId, chance in pairs(spec.Drops) do
				if math.random() <= chance then
					_G.RelicService.SpawnRelic(tierId, mob.Position, killerPlayer.UserId)
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if spec.RespawnTime and spec.RespawnTime > 0 then
			mob.RespawnAt = os.clock() + spec.RespawnTime
		else
			ActiveMobsByNetId[mob.NetId] = nil
		end
	end

	broadcastMetadata(nil)
end

local function canEngagePvP(attacker: Player, defender: Player): (boolean, string?)
	if attacker == defender then
		return false, "Cannot target your own squad!"
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local atkPos = getMasterRootPosition(attacker)
	if not atkPos then
		return false, "Attacker position not found"
	end
	local atkR = math.sqrt(atkPos.X * atkPos.X + atkPos.Z * atkPos.Z)
	if atkR > 460 then
		return false, "Cannot engage in PvP inside the Safe Zone (Perimeter Highway / Plots)!"
	end

	-- 1. Attacker has active theft grudge against defender
	if TheftGrudges[attacker.UserId] and (TheftGrudges[attacker.UserId][defender.UserId] or 0) > now then
		return true, nil
	end

	-- 2. Defender is currently flagged as Loot Thief
	local defChar = defender.Character
	if defChar and defChar:GetAttribute("IsLootThief") == true then
		return true, nil
	end

	-- 3. Mutual Retaliation: Defender previously attacked attacker
	if TheftGrudges[defender.UserId] and (TheftGrudges[defender.UserId][attacker.UserId] or 0) > now then
		return true, nil
	end

	return false, string.format("%s is not flagged as a Loot Thief against you!", defender.DisplayName)
end

						simHero.PacifiedUntil = 0

local function stepWorldBoss(boss: SimMob, dt: number, now: number)
	if not boss.IsAlive then
		return
	end
	local dm = getDataManager()

	if boss.DespawnAt and now >= boss.DespawnAt then
		boss.IsAlive = false
		ActiveWorldBoss = nil
		ProgressionHits[boss.NetId] = nil
		ActiveMobsByNetId[boss.NetId] = nil
		dm.BroadcastToast("⏳ The Dimensional Sovereign tore open a rift and vanished (5m timer expired)!", "WARN")
		broadcastMetadata(nil)
		return
	end

	local hpRatio = boss.CurrentHP / math.max(1, boss.MaxHP)
	if hpRatio <= 0.25 then
		boss.Phase = 3
	elseif hpRatio <= 0.50 then
		boss.Phase = 2
	else
		boss.Phase = 1
	end

	-- 1. Devouring Nova 3.0s Telegraph (Strictly every 20.0s)
	if boss.NovaDetonateTime == nil and now >= boss.NextNovaCastTime then
		boss.NovaDetonateTime = now + NOVA_TELEGRAPH_DURATION
		boss.NextNovaCastTime = now + NOVA_INTERVAL

		-- Phase 2+ Gravity Well: Pull all heroes on Ring 3 inward before Nova telegraph
		if boss.Phase >= 2 then
			for _, simHero in pairs(ActiveHeroesByNetId) do
				local dist = getHorizontalDistance(simHero.Position, WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN)
				if dist <= 120 and math.abs(simHero.Position.Y - WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN.Y) < 10 then
					local dir = (simHero.Position - WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN)
					local unitXZ = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
					unitXZ = (unitXZ.Magnitude > 0.01) and unitXZ.Unit or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
					local p = WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN + (unitXZ * 15.0)
					HeroNavigation.Displace(simHero, p)
				end
			end
		end

		BossTelegraphRemote:FireAllClients(
			1, -- 1 = DEVOURING_NOVA
			Vector2int16.new(math.round(WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN.X), math.round(WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN.Z)),
			NOVA_BLAST_RADIUS,
			math.round(NOVA_TELEGRAPH_DURATION * 1000)
		)
	end

	-- 2. Devouring Nova Detonation (t = 3.0s)
	if boss.NovaDetonateTime ~= nil and now >= boss.NovaDetonateTime then
		boss.NovaDetonateTime = nil
		boss.PunishWindowUntil = now + NOVA_PUNISH_DURATION

		BossTelegraphRemote:FireAllClients(
			2, -- 2 = CORE_EXPOSED_PUNISH_WINDOW (5.0s +25% DMG!)
			Vector2int16.new(0, 0),
			NOVA_BLAST_RADIUS,
			math.round(NOVA_PUNISH_DURATION * 1000)
		)

		-- Check Heroes inside R <= 85 studs ("Greed vs. Coma")
		local toComa = {}
		for _, simHero in pairs(ActiveHeroesByNetId) do
			if simHero.State ~= "COMA" then
				local distFromAltar = getHorizontalDistance(simHero.Position, WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN)
				if distFromAltar <= NOVA_BLAST_RADIUS then
					if simHero.Stamina > 50.0 and boss.Phase == 1 then
						simHero.Stamina = math.max(0, simHero.Stamina - 50.0)
						simHero.CurrentHP = math.max(1, simHero.CurrentHP - math.round(simHero.MaxHP * 0.40))
						local profile = dm.GetProfile(simHero.Owner)
						if profile and profile.Heroes[simHero.HeroUUID] then
							profile.Heroes[simHero.HeroUUID].CurrentStamina = simHero.Stamina
						end
						dm.SendToast(simHero.Owner, string.format("⚠️ %s was hit by Devouring Nova (-50 Stamina)! Use [E] Recall from the Safe Rim!", simHero.DisplayName), "WARN")
					else
						table.insert(toComa, simHero)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, h in ipairs(toComa) do
			knockHeroIntoComa(h, COMA_DURATION_DEFAULT)
		end

		-- Also check if any Relic Carrier is inside R <= 85 studs -> Fumble!
		if _G.RelicService then
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local mPos = getMasterRootPosition(p)
				if mPos and getHorizontalDistance(mPos, WORLD_BOSS_ORIGIN) <= NOVA_BLAST_RADIUS then
					_G.RelicService.FumbleRelicOnAoEHit(p)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function stepMobAndEliteAoEs(mob: SimMob, dt: number, now: number)
	if not mob.IsAlive then
		if mob.RespawnAt > 0 and now >= mob.RespawnAt then
			mob.IsAlive = true
			mob.CurrentHP = mob.MaxHP
			mob.Position = mob.HomePosition
			mob.RespawnAt = 0
			broadcastMetadata(nil)
		end
		return
	end

	if mob.MobType == "WORLD_BOSS" then
		stepWorldBoss(mob, dt, now)
		return
	end

	if mob.AoERadius > 0 and mob.NextAoECastTime > 0 then
		local spec = (WorldBossConfig.MobSpecs :: any)[mob.SpecId]
		local castDuration = spec and spec.AoECastTime or 2.0
		local cooldown = spec and spec.AoECooldown or 10.0

		if mob.AoEDetonateTime == nil and now >= mob.NextAoECastTime then
			-- Only cast AoE if a hero or player is within 35 studs
			local hasNearby = false
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local mPos = getMasterRootPosition(p)
				if mPos and getHorizontalDistance(mPos, mob.Position) <= 35 then
					hasNearby = true
					break
				end
			end
			if hasNearby then
				mob.AoEDetonateTime = now + castDuration
				mob.NextAoECastTime = now + cooldown
				BossTelegraphRemote:FireAllClients(
					3, -- 3 = ELITE_AOE_CIRCLE
					Vector2int16.new(math.round(mob.Position.X), math.round(mob.Position.Z)),
					mob.AoERadius,
					math.round(castDuration * 1000)
				)
			else
				mob.NextAoECastTime = now + 2.0
			end
		elseif mob.AoEDetonateTime ~= nil and now >= mob.AoEDetonateTime then
			mob.AoEDetonateTime = nil
			-- Check Hero hits
			local comas = {}
			for _, simHero in pairs(ActiveHeroesByNetId) do
				if getHorizontalDistance(simHero.Position, mob.Position) <= mob.AoERadius then
					simHero.Stamina = math.max(0, simHero.Stamina - 15)
					simHero.CurrentHP -= mob.ATK * 2
					if simHero.CurrentHP <= 0 or simHero.Stamina <= 0 then
						table.insert(comas, simHero)
					end
				end
			end
			for _, h in ipairs(comas) do
				knockHeroIntoComa(h, COMA_DURATION_DEFAULT)
			end
			-- Check Relic Carrier Fumbles!
			if _G.RelicService then
				for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					local mPos = getMasterRootPosition(p)
					if mPos and getHorizontalDistance(mPos, mob.Position) <= mob.AoERadius then
						_G.RelicService.FumbleRelicOnAoEHit(p)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function resolveTargetPositionAndAlive(simHero: SimHero): (Vector3?, SimMob?, SimHero?)
	local targetNetId = simHero.TargetNetId
	if targetNetId then
		local mob = ActiveMobsByNetId[targetNetId]
		if mob and mob.IsAlive then
			return mob.Position, mob, nil
		end
		local enemyHero = ActiveHeroesByNetId[targetNetId]
		if enemyHero and enemyHero.State ~= "COMA" and enemyHero.CurrentHP > 0 then
			return enemyHero.Position, nil, enemyHero
		end
	end

	-- Check if Master has an active TargetEnemyUserId to switch to another living hero in that squad!
	local masterState = ActiveMasters[simHero.Owner]
	if masterState and masterState.TargetEnemyUserId then
		local enemyPlayer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(masterState.TargetEnemyUserId)
		local enemyMasterState = enemyPlayer and ActiveMasters[enemyPlayer]
		if enemyMasterState then
			local nearestHero: SimHero? = nil
			local nearestDist = 9999
			for _, h in pairs(enemyMasterState.DeployedHeroes) do
				if h.State ~= "COMA" and h.CurrentHP > 0 then
					local d = getHorizontalDistance(simHero.Position, h.Position)
					if d < nearestDist then
						nearestDist = d
						nearestHero = h
					end
				end
			end
			if nearestHero then
				simHero.TargetNetId = nearestHero.NetId
				return nearestHero.Position, nil, nearestHero
			else
				-- All heroes in enemy squad are defeated
				masterState.TargetEnemyUserId = nil
				masterState.FocusedTargetNetId = nil
				simHero.TargetNetId = nil
				local dm = getDataManager()
				dm.SendToast(simHero.Owner, string.format("🏆 Defeated %s's squad!", enemyPlayer.DisplayName), "SUCCESS")
			end
		else
			masterState.TargetEnemyUserId = nil
		end
	end

	return nil, nil, nil
end

local function stepHeroSimulation(simHero: SimHero, dt: number, now: number)
	if simHero.State == "COMA" then
		return
	end
	local masterPos = getMasterRootPosition(simHero.Owner)
	if not masterPos then
		return
	end

	local dm = getDataManager()
	local profile = dm.GetProfile(simHero.Owner)
	if profile and profile.Heroes[simHero.HeroUUID] then
		local effATK, effHP, _ = StatFormulas.GetEffectiveCombatStats(profile.Heroes[simHero.HeroUUID], false, false)
		simHero.EffectiveATK = effATK
		simHero.MaxHP = effHP
	end

	local masterState = ActiveMasters[simHero.Owner]
	local maxLeash = (masterState and masterState.TargetEnemyUserId ~= nil) and 150.0 or LEASH_DISTANCE
	if getHorizontalDistance(simHero.Position, masterPos) > maxLeash or math.abs(simHero.Position.Y - masterPos.Y) > 15 then
		simHero.TargetNetId = nil
		simHero.State = "FOLLOW_MASTER"
	end

	local isPacified = now < simHero.PacifiedUntil
	if isPacified then
		simHero.TargetNetId = nil
		simHero.State = "FOLLOW_MASTER"
	end

	local isOverdrive = now < simHero.OverdriveUntil
	local isExhausted = simHero.Stamina <= 0.0
	local currentMoveSpeed = simHero.MoveSpeed
		* (isOverdrive and 1.20 or 1.0)
		* (isExhausted and 0.50 or 1.0)

	local targetPos, targetMob, targetEnemyHero = resolveTargetPositionAndAlive(simHero)

	if not targetPos and not isPacified then
		local nearestDist = 30.0
		local nearestMobId: number? = nil
		for netId, mob in pairs(ActiveMobsByNetId) do
			if mob.IsAlive and math.abs(mob.Position.Y - simHero.Position.Y) < 12 and math.abs(mob.Position.Y - masterPos.Y) < 12 then
				local d = getHorizontalDistance(masterPos, mob.Position)
				if d < nearestDist then
					nearestDist = d
					nearestMobId = netId
				end
			end
		end
		if nearestMobId then
			simHero.TargetNetId = nearestMobId
			targetPos, targetMob, targetEnemyHero = resolveTargetPositionAndAlive(simHero)
			simHero.State = "MOVE_TO_TARGET"
		else
			simHero.State = "FOLLOW_MASTER"
		end
	end

	if simHero.State == "FOLLOW_MASTER" or not targetPos then
		local goalPos = HeroNavigation.PlaceNear(masterPos, getFormationOffset(simHero.SlotIndex))
		if (goalPos - simHero.Position).Magnitude > .5 then
			HeroNavigation.Step(simHero, goalPos, currentMoveSpeed * dt, now)
		end
		return
	end

	local distToTarget = (simHero.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
	if distToTarget > simHero.AttackRange or not HeroNavigation.CanAttack(simHero.Position, targetPos) then
		simHero.State = "MOVE_TO_TARGET"
		local stepDist = math.min(math.max(.5, distToTarget - simHero.AttackRange * .85), currentMoveSpeed * dt)
		HeroNavigation.Step(simHero, targetPos, stepDist, now)
	else
		simHero.State = "ATTACKING"
		local delta = targetPos - simHero.Position
		if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			simHero.Yaw = math.atan2(-delta.X, -delta.Z)
		end

		local drainRate = getZoneStaminaDrainPerSec(simHero.Position)
		simHero.Stamina = math.max(0.0, simHero.Stamina - (drainRate * dt))
		if profile and profile.Heroes[simHero.HeroUUID] then
			profile.Heroes[simHero.HeroUUID].CurrentStamina = simHero.Stamina
		end

		local effectiveInterval = simHero.AttackInterval / (isOverdrive and OVERDRIVE_ATK_SPEED_MULT or 1.0)
		simHero.AttackCooldown -= dt
		if simHero.AttackCooldown <= 0 then
			simHero.AttackCooldown = effectiveInterval
			local exhaustionScalar = isExhausted and 0.20 or 1.00
			local damage = math.round(simHero.EffectiveATK * exhaustionScalar)

			if targetMob then
				if targetMob.MobType == "WORLD_BOSS" and now < targetMob.PunishWindowUntil then
					damage = math.round(damage * NOVA_PUNISH_DAMAGE_MULT)
				end
				local actualDamage = math.min(targetMob.CurrentHP, damage)
				local participation = ProgressionHits[targetMob.NetId]
				if not participation then
					participation = {}
					ProgressionHits[targetMob.NetId] = participation
				end
				local previous = participation[simHero.NetId]
				participation[simHero.NetId] = { Damage = (previous and previous.Damage or 0) + actualDamage, At = now }
				targetMob.CurrentHP = math.max(0, targetMob.CurrentHP - damage)
				targetMob.DamageLedger[simHero.Owner.UserId] = (targetMob.DamageLedger[simHero.Owner.UserId] or 0) + damage

				CombatVFXRemote:FireAllClients("HIT_SPARK", targetMob.Position, damage, isOverdrive)

				if targetMob.CurrentHP <= 0 then
					simHero.TargetNetId = nil
					simHero.State = "FOLLOW_MASTER"
					handleMobDeath(targetMob, simHero.Owner)
				end
			elseif targetEnemyHero then
				local pvpDamage = math.max(1, math.round(damage * 0.25))
				targetEnemyHero.CurrentHP = math.max(0, targetEnemyHero.CurrentHP - pvpDamage)
				CombatVFXRemote:FireAllClients("HIT_SPARK", targetEnemyHero.Position, pvpDamage, isOverdrive)

				-- Defending hero and defending Master auto-retaliate
				if targetEnemyHero.State == "FOLLOW_MASTER" or targetEnemyHero.TargetNetId == nil then
					targetEnemyHero.TargetNetId = simHero.NetId
					targetEnemyHero.State = "MOVE_TO_TARGET"
				end
				local defMasterState = ActiveMasters[targetEnemyHero.Owner]
				if defMasterState and not defMasterState.TargetEnemyUserId then
					defMasterState.TargetEnemyUserId = simHero.Owner.UserId
					TheftGrudges[targetEnemyHero.Owner.UserId] = TheftGrudges[targetEnemyHero.Owner.UserId] or {}
					TheftGrudges[targetEnemyHero.Owner.UserId][simHero.Owner.UserId] = now + 180
				end

				if targetEnemyHero.CurrentHP <= 0 then
					knockHeroIntoComa(targetEnemyHero, 30)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--============================================================================
-- 9. COMPACT BINARY BUFFER SERIALIZATION & 5 HZ HEARTBEAT
--============================================================================

local STATE_TO_ENUM: { [HeroSimState]: number } = {
	FOLLOW_MASTER = 1,
	MOVE_TO_TARGET = 2,
	ATTACKING = 3,
	COMA = 4,
}

local function broadcastReplicationSnapshot(now: number)
	local entities: { any } = {}
	for _, h in pairs(ActiveHeroesByNetId) do
		table.insert(entities, { IsHero = true, Ref = h })
	end
	for _, m in pairs(ActiveMobsByNetId) do
		if m.IsAlive then
			table.insert(entities, { IsHero = false, Ref = m })
		end
	end

	local count = math.min(#entities, 255)
	-- Keep every unreliable packet below Roblox's 1 KB payload limit.
	for batchStart = 1, count, 64 do
		local batchCount = math.min(64, count - batchStart + 1)
		local buf = buffer.create(5 + (batchCount * 14))
		buffer.writeu8(buf, 0, batchCount)
		buffer.writef32(buf, 1, now)

		local offset = 5
		for i = batchStart, batchStart + batchCount - 1 do
			local entry = entities[i]
			local e = entry.Ref
			buffer.writeu16(buf, offset + 0, e.NetId)
			buffer.writei16(buf, offset + 2, math.clamp(math.round(e.Position.X * 10), -32767, 32767))
			buffer.writei16(buf, offset + 4, math.clamp(math.round(e.Position.Z * 10), -32767, 32767))

			local yawByte = math.clamp(math.round(((e.Yaw or 0) + math.pi) / (2 * math.pi) * 255), 0, 255)
			buffer.writeu8(buf, offset + 6, yawByte)

			local stateByte = entry.IsHero and (STATE_TO_ENUM[e.State] or 1) or (10 + (e.Phase or 1))
			buffer.writeu8(buf, offset + 7, stateByte)

			local hpPermille = math.clamp(math.round((e.CurrentHP / math.max(1, e.MaxHP)) * 1000), 0, 1000)
			buffer.writeu16(buf, offset + 8, hpPermille)

			local staminaByte = entry.IsHero and math.clamp(math.round(e.Stamina), 0, 100) or 100
			buffer.writeu8(buf, offset + 10, staminaByte)

			local flags = 0
			if entry.IsHero then
				if now < e.OverdriveUntil then
					flags = bit32.bor(flags, 1)
				end
				if now < e.PacifiedUntil then
					flags = bit32.bor(flags, 2)
				end
			elseif e.MobType == "WORLD_BOSS" and now < e.PunishWindowUntil then
				flags = bit32.bor(flags, 4) -- Core Exposed (+25% DMG)
			end
			buffer.writeu8(buf, offset + 11, flags)
			buffer.writei16(buf, offset + 12, math.clamp(math.round(e.Position.Y * 10), -32767, 32767))
			offset += 14
		end

		ReplicationTickRemote:FireAllClients(buf)
	end
end

-- Unpack 5 Hz Binary Buffer Snapshot
ReplicationTickRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(buf: buffer)
	local count = buffer.readu8(buf, 0)
	-- Height is authoritative; radius alone cannot identify stacked tower floors.
	local stride = count > 0 and (buffer.len(buf) - 5) / count or 14
	if stride ~= 14 and stride ~= 12 then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local offset = 5
	local needsMetadata = false

	for i = 1, count do
		local netId = buffer.readu16(buf, offset + 0)
		local posX = buffer.readi16(buf, offset + 2) / 10.0
		local posZ = buffer.readi16(buf, offset + 4) / 10.0
		local yawByte = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 6)
		local stateEnum = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 7)
		local hpPermille = buffer.readu16(buf, offset + 8)
		local stamina = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 10)
		local flags = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 11)
		local y = stride == 14 and buffer.readi16(buf, offset + 12) / 10 or getGroundY(posX, posZ)
		offset += stride

		local yaw = ((yawByte / 255.0) * (math.pi * 2)) - math.pi
		local goalPos = Vector3.new(posX, y, posZ)

		local meta = MetadataByNetId[netId]
		local node = VisualNodesByNetId[netId]
		if not meta then
			-- Identity is not in the snapshot; wait for it instead of rendering heroes as mobs.
			needsMetadata = true
			if node then
				node.Model:Destroy()
				VisualNodesByNetId[netId] = nil
			end
			continue
		end
		if not node then
			node = createEntityModel(netId, meta, goalPos)
			VisualNodesByNetId[netId] = node
		end

		node.GoalPos = goalPos
		node.GoalYaw = yaw
		node.HpPermille = hpPermille
		node.Stamina = stamina
		node.StateEnum = stateEnum
		node.Flags = flags
		node.LastSeenClock = now

		if node.HPBarFill then
			node.HPBarFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(hpPermille / 1000.0, 0, 1), 1)
		end
		if node.StamBarFill then
			node.StamBarFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(stamina / 100.0, 0, 1), 1)
		end

		-- Check Overdrive / Focused Highlight
		if node.Highlight then
			local isOverdrive = bit32.band(flags, 1) ~= 0
			local isFocused = (_G.ClientCombatState.FocusedNetId == netId)
			if isFocused then
				node.Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 235)
				node.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
			elseif isOverdrive then
				node.Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 195, 40)
				node.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
			else
				node.Highlight.OutlineColor = node.IsHero and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
				node.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.25
			end
		end

		if meta and meta.MobType == "WORLD_BOSS" then
			_G.ClientCombatState.WorldBossNetId = netId
			_G.ClientCombatState.WorldBossHPPerMille = hpPermille
			_G.ClientCombatState.WorldBossPhase = math.max(1, stateEnum - 10)
			_G.ClientCombatState.WorldBossCoreExposed = (bit32.band(flags, 4) ~= 0)
		end
	end
	if needsMetadata then
		requestEntityMetadata()
	end

	-- Clean up stale entities not seen for > 0.8s
	for netId, node in pairs(VisualNodesByNetId) do
		if (now - node.LastSeenClock) > 0.85 then
			node.Model:Destroy()
			VisualNodesByNetId[netId] = nil
			if _G.ClientCombatState.WorldBossNetId == netId then
				_G.ClientCombatState.WorldBossNetId = nil
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- 60 FPS Smooth Interpolation Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
	local alpha = math.clamp(dt * 12.0, 0, 1)
	for _, node in pairs(VisualNodesByNetId) do
		if (node.GoalPos - node.CurrentPos).Magnitude > 35 then

	end

-- Server-side collision and waypoint following for lightweight heroes (no Humanoids).
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Navigation = {}
local states: {[any]: any} = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) :: any
local computing = 0
local RADIUS, HEIGHT, STEP_UP, MAX_DROP = 1.2, 4.8, 2.2, 3.5
local exclusions: {Instance} = {}

local function refreshExclusions()
	local list: {Instance} = {}
	for _, name in {"ClientVisualEntities", "PhysicalLoot", "PhysicalRelics", "ModelViewer"} do
		local f = Workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if f then table.insert(list, f) end
	end

	exclusions = list
end
refreshExclusions()
local function trackPlayer(player: Player)

	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() task.defer(refreshExclusions) end)
end
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do trackPlayer(player) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(trackPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() task.defer(refreshExclusions) end)
Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(refreshExclusions)

local function parameters(group: string?): RaycastParams
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType, p.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, exclusions
	p.RespectCanCollide, p.IgnoreWater = true, true
	p.CollisionGroup = group or "Default"
	return p
end

function Navigation.Ground(position: Vector3, group: string?, up: number?, down: number?): Vector3?
	local rise, drop = up or STEP_UP, down or MAX_DROP
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, rise, 0), Vector3.new(0, -(rise + drop), 0), parameters(group))
	if hit and hit.Normal.Y >= .65 then return hit.Position end
	return nil
end

local function groupFor(hero: any): string
	local owner = hero.Owner
	local char = owner and owner.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.CollisionGroup or "Default"
end

-- Every substep must have support and enough clearance for the hero's whole body.
local function walkSegment(from: Vector3, toward: Vector3, distance: number, group: string): (Vector3, boolean)
	local flat = Vector3.new(toward.X - from.X, 0, toward.Z - from.Z)
	local length = flat.Magnitude
	if length < .02 then return from, math.abs(toward.Y - from.Y) < STEP_UP end
	local direction = flat.Unit
	local travel = math.min(distance, length)
	local steps = math.max(1, math.ceil(travel / 1.5))
	local at = from
	local params = parameters(group)
	for _ = 1, steps do
		local candidate = at + direction * (travel / steps)
		local ground = Navigation.Ground(candidate, group)
		if not ground then return at, false end
		local delta = ground - at
		-- Raise the sweep above small walkable steps; the ground probe limits step height.
		local hit = Workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)), Vector3.new(RADIUS * 2, 2.5, RADIUS * 2), delta, params)
		if hit then return at, false end
		-- Probe the leading edges as well so formations cannot walk off narrow bridges.
		local across = Vector3.new(-direction.Z, 0, direction.X) * (RADIUS * .8)
		if not Navigation.Ground(ground + across, group, .5, 2.5) or not Navigation.Ground(ground - across, group, .5, 2.5) then return at, false end
		at = ground
	end
	return at, true
end

local function clearRoute(from: Vector3, goal: Vector3, group: string): boolean
	local distance = (Vector3.new(goal.X, from.Y, goal.Z) - from).Magnitude
	if distance > 32 or math.abs(from.Y - goal.Y) > 7 then return false end
	local at, clear = walkSegment(from, goal, distance, group)
	return clear and (at - goal).Magnitude < 2.5
end

function Navigation.Clear(hero: any)
	states[hero] = nil
end

function Navigation.Displace(hero: any, destination: Vector3)
	local flat = Vector3.new(destination.X, hero.Position.Y, destination.Z)
	hero.Position = walkSegment(hero.Position, flat, (flat - hero.Position).Magnitude, groupFor(hero))
	Navigation.Clear(hero)
end

function Navigation.PlaceNear(masterRoot: Vector3, offset: Vector3, group: string?): Vector3
	local feet = masterRoot - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	local base = Navigation.Ground(feet, group, 3, 8) or feet
	local desired = Navigation.Ground(base + offset, group)
	if desired and clearRoute(base, desired, group or "Default") then return desired end
	return base
end

local function requestPath(hero: any, state: any, goal: Vector3, now: number)
	if state.Pending or now < state.NextRequest or computing >= 3 then return end
	state.Pending, state.NextRequest = true, now + 1
	computing += 1
	local start = hero.Position
	task.spawn(function()
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius = 2, AgentHeight = HEIGHT, AgentCanJump = false, AgentCanClimb = false, WaypointSpacing = 3})
		local ok = pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(start, goal) end)
		computing -= 1
		if states[hero] ~= state then path:Destroy(); return end
		state.Pending = false
		if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success and (hero.Position - start).Magnitude < 12 then
			state.Points, state.Index, state.Goal = path:GetWaypoints(), 2, goal
		else
			state.Points = nil
		end
		path:Destroy()
	end)
end

function Navigation.Step(hero: any, goal: Vector3, distance: number, now: number)
	local state = states[hero]
	if not state then state = {NextRequest = 0, Index = 2}; states[hero] = state end
	local group = groupFor(hero)
	local supportedGoal = Navigation.Ground(goal, group, 2, 6)
	if not supportedGoal then return end
	goal = supportedGoal
	local old = hero.Position
	local destination = goal
	if clearRoute(old, goal, group) then
		state.Points = nil
	else
		if not state.Goal or (state.Goal - goal).Magnitude > 7 or not state.Points then requestPath(hero, state, goal, now) end
		local points = state.Points
		if not points then return end
		while points[state.Index] and (points[state.Index].Position - hero.Position).Magnitude < 1.3 do state.Index += 1 end
		local point = points[state.Index]
		if not point then state.Points = nil; return end
		destination = point.Position
	end
	local nextPosition, clear = walkSegment(old, destination, distance, group)
	-- Sweep against other heroes too, so a fast tick cannot move through a squadmate.
	for other in pairs(states) do
		if other ~= hero and other.State ~= "COMA" and other.Position and math.abs(other.Position.Y - nextPosition.Y) < 3 then
			local movement = Vector3.new(nextPosition.X - old.X, 0, nextPosition.Z - old.Z)
			local offset = Vector3.new(other.Position.X - old.X, 0, other.Position.Z - old.Z)
			local function clearance(delta: Vector3): number
				local t = delta.Magnitude > .01 and math.clamp(offset:Dot(delta) / delta:Dot(delta), 0, 1) or 0
				return (offset - delta * t).Magnitude
			end
			if movement.Magnitude > .01 and clearance(movement) < 2.3 and offset:Dot(movement) > 0 then
				local sideways = Vector3.new(-movement.Z, 0, movement.X).Unit * movement.Magnitude
				local yielded = old
				for _, side in {1, -1} do
					local trial, safe = walkSegment(old, old + sideways * side, movement.Magnitude, group)
					local trialDelta = Vector3.new(trial.X - old.X, 0, trial.Z - old.Z)
					if safe and clearance(trialDelta) >= math.min(2.3, offset.Magnitude - .01) then yielded = trial; break end
				end
				nextPosition = yielded
			end
		end
	end
	hero.Position = nextPosition
	local moved = nextPosition - old
	if moved.Magnitude > .02 then hero.Yaw = math.atan2(-moved.X, -moved.Z) end
	if not clear then state.Points = nil; state.NextRequest = math.min(state.NextRequest, now + .2) end
end

function Navigation.CanAttack(from: Vector3, target: Vector3, group: string?): boolean
	if math.abs(from.Y - target.Y) > 6 then return false end
	local a, b = from + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), target + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
	return Workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, parameters(group)) == nil
end

return Navigation

local function getCharacterParts(player: Player): (Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return nil, nil
	end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	return hum, hrp
end

function RelicService.StunPlayer(player: Player, durationSec: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	PlayerStunnedUntil[player] = math.max(PlayerStunnedUntil[player] or 0, now + durationSec)
end

local function updateMasterMovementAttributes(player: Player, now: number)
	local hum, hrp = getCharacterParts(player)
	if not hum or not hrp then
		return
	end

	local stunnedUntil = PlayerStunnedUntil[player] or 0
	if now < stunnedUntil then
		hum.WalkSpeed = 0
		hum.JumpPower = 0
		return
	end

	local relic = CarrierToRelic[player]
	if not relic then
		hum.WalkSpeed = BASE_WALKSPEED
		hum.JumpPower = BASE_JUMPPOWER
		return
	end

	local spec = RelicConfig[relic.TierId]
	local penalty = spec.WalkSpeedPenalty

	local dm = getDataManager()
	local rogueBonus = (dm and dm.IsPlayerRogue and dm.IsPlayerRogue(player)) and 0.10 or 0.0

	local multiplier = math.clamp(1.0 - penalty + rogueBonus, 0.35, 1.25)
	hum.WalkSpeed = BASE_WALKSPEED * multiplier
	hum.JumpPower = spec.DisableJump and 0 or BASE_JUMPPOWER
end

function RelicService.TryPickupRelic(player: Player, relic: ActiveRelic): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	if relic.Carrier ~= nil or CarrierToRelic[player] ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	if player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("CarryingLoot") == true then return false end
	if relic.PickupBlockedUserId == player.UserId and now < (relic.PickupBlockedUntil or 0) then return false end
	if now < (PlayerStunnedUntil[player] or 0) then
		return false
	end
	if relic.LockedUserId and relic.LockedUserId ~= player.UserId and now < relic.LockExpiresAt then
		return false
	end
	if player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("SquadWiped") == true then
		local dm = getDataManager()
		dm.SendToast(player, "🚫 SQUAD DOWN! You cannot carry relics until you recover your squad at your Waiting Room!", "WARN")
		return false
	end

	local hum, hrp = getCharacterParts(player)
	if not hum or not hrp or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	if (hrp.Position - relic.Part.Position).Magnitude > 9.5 then
		return false
	end

	relic.Part.Anchored = false
	relic.Part.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5.2, 0)

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = hrp
	weld.Part1 = relic.Part
	weld.Parent = relic.Part

	relic.Weld = weld
	relic.Carrier = player
	CarrierToRelic[player] = relic
	if player.Character then
		player.Character:SetAttribute("CarryingRelic", relic.TierId)
	end

	local dm = getDataManager()
	local spec = RelicConfig[relic.TierId]

	updateMasterMovementAttributes(player, now)
	dm.SendToast(player, string.format("Carrying %s (-%d%% Spd)! Bring to your Extraction Pad!", spec.DisplayName, math.round(spec.WalkSpeedPenalty * 100)), "INFO")
	RelicStateRemote:FireAllClients(relic.RelicId, relic.TierId, "PICKUP", player.UserId, 0)
	return true
end

function RelicService.DropCarriedRelic(carrier: Player): boolean
	local relic = CarrierToRelic[carrier]
	if not relic then return false end
	if relic.Weld then
		relic.Weld:Destroy()
		relic.Weld = nil
	end
	local _, root = getCharacterParts(carrier)
	local position = root and (root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * 8) or relic.Part.Position
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {carrier.Character or relic.Part, PhysicalRelicsFolder, Workspace.PhysicalLoot}
	local ground = Workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Vector3.new(0, -64, 0), params)
	relic.Part.Anchored = true
	relic.Part.Position = ground and (ground.Position + Vector3.new(0, relic.Part.Size.Y / 2 + 0.2, 0)) or position
	relic.Carrier = nil
	CarrierToRelic[carrier] = nil
	relic.LockedUserId = nil
	relic.LockExpiresAt = 0
	relic.PickupBlockedUserId = carrier.UserId
	relic.PickupBlockedUntil = os.clock() + 1.5
	if carrier.Character then carrier.Character:SetAttribute("CarryingRelic", nil) end
	updateMasterMovementAttributes(carrier, os.clock())
	RelicStateRemote:FireAllClients(relic.RelicId, relic.TierId, "DROP", carrier.UserId, 0)
	return true
end

function RelicService.FumbleRelicOnAoEHit(carrier: Player)
	local relic = CarrierToRelic[carrier]
	if not relic then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if relic.Weld then
		relic.Weld:Destroy()
		relic.Weld = nil
	end

	local _, hrp = getCharacterParts(carrier)
	local dropPos = hrp and (hrp.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 2)) or relic.Part.Position

	relic.Carrier = nil
	CarrierToRelic[carrier] = nil
	if carrier.Character then
		carrier.Character:SetAttribute("CarryingRelic", nil)
	end

	relic.Part.Anchored = true
	relic.Part.Position = Vector3.new(dropPos.X, math.max(3.5, dropPos.Y), dropPos.Z)
	relic.LockedUserId = carrier.UserId
	relic.LockExpiresAt = now + FUMBLE_OWNER_LOCK_SECONDS

	PlayerStunnedUntil[carrier] = math.max(PlayerStunnedUntil[carrier] or 0, now + FUMBLE_STUN_SECONDS)
	updateMasterMovementAttributes(carrier, now)

	local dm = getDataManager()
	dm.SendToast(carrier, "💥 AoE Hit! Stunned 1.0s & Fumbled Relic (3.0s Owner-Lock before stealable)!", "WARN")
	RelicStateRemote:FireAllClients(relic.RelicId, relic.TierId, "FUMBLE", carrier.UserId, relic.LockExpiresAt)
end

local function awardRelicPayout(player: Player, spec: any, scalar: number)
	local dm = getDataManager()
	local profile = dm.GetProfile(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local gems = math.round(spec.Payout.Gems * scalar)
	local gold = math.round(spec.Payout.Gold * scalar)

	profile.Currencies.Gems += gems
	profile.Currencies.Gold += gold

	if spec.TierId == "CALAMITY_HEART" and math.random() <= 0.25 then
		local uuid, archon = dm.CreateHeroFromSeed("hero_archon", 1.10)
		profile.Heroes[uuid] = archon
		dm.BroadcastToast(string.format("👑 %s extracted THE CALAMITY HEART and rolled 3★ SOVEREIGN ARCHON!", player.DisplayName), "SUCCESS")
	end

	dm.SendToast(
		player,
		string.format("Extracted %s (%d%%): +%d Gems, +%d Gold!", spec.DisplayName, math.round(scalar * 100), gems, gold),
		"SUCCESS"
	)
	dm.SyncProfile(player)
end

local function destroyRelicInstance(relic: ActiveRelic)
	if relic.Carrier then
		local carrier = relic.Carrier
		CarrierToRelic[carrier] = nil
		if carrier.Character then
			carrier.Character:SetAttribute("CarryingRelic", nil)
		end
		relic.Carrier = nil
		updateMasterMovementAttributes(carrier, os.clock())
	end
	if relic.Weld then
		relic.Weld:Destroy()
	end
	if relic.Part then
		relic.Part:Destroy()
	end
	ActiveRelics[relic.RelicId] = nil
end

function RelicService.ExtractOnPrivatePad(carrier: Player)
	local relic = CarrierToRelic[carrier]
	if not relic then
		return
	end
	local dm = getDataManager()
	local profile = dm.GetProfile(carrier)
	if not profile then
		return
	end

	local spec = RelicConfig[relic.TierId]
	awardRelicPayout(carrier, spec, 1.00)
	RelicStateRemote:FireAllClients(relic.RelicId, relic.TierId, "EXTRACT_PRIVATE", carrier.UserId, 0)
	destroyRelicInstance(relic)
end

-- Heartbeat for Relic Pickups, Billboard Timers & Extraction Pad Detection
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local now = os.clock()

	for _, relic in pairs(ActiveRelics) do
		local spec = RelicConfig[relic.TierId]
		if relic.Carrier == nil then
			if now >= relic.DespawnAt then
				destroyRelicInstance(relic)
			else
				if relic.BillboardStatus then
					local remDespawn = math.max(0, math.ceil(relic.DespawnAt - now))
					if relic.LockedUserId and now < relic.LockExpiresAt then
						relic.BillboardStatus.Text = string.format("🔒 LOCKED: %.1fs | Despawn: %ds", relic.LockExpiresAt - now, remDespawn)
						relic.BillboardStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 45)
					else
						relic.BillboardStatus.Text = string.format("🔓 STEALABLE NOW! (-%d%% Spd) | %ds", math.round(spec.WalkSpeedPenalty * 100), remDespawn)
						relic.BillboardStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(95, 255, 135)
					end
				end

				for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					local _, hrp = getCharacterParts(player)
					if hrp and (hrp.Position - relic.Part.Position).Magnitude <= 6.8 then
						if RelicService.TryPickupRelic(player, relic) then
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- Relic is being carried: check Private Extraction Pads on Waiting Room Plots
			local carrier = relic.Carrier
			local _, hrp = getCharacterParts(carrier)
			if hrp then
				if relic.BillboardStatus then
					relic.BillboardStatus.Text = string.format("CARRIED BY %s (-%d%% SPD)", carrier.DisplayName, math.round(spec.WalkSpeedPenalty * 100))
					relic.BillboardStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 235, 115)
				end

				-- Check Private Extraction Pad on Carrier's Plot (or any plot if testing)
				for _, plotModel in ipairs(PlotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
					local ownerId = plotModel:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")
					if ownerId == carrier.UserId or ownerId == 0 then
						local pad = plotModel:FindFirstChild("PrivateExtractionPad") :: BasePart?
						if pad and (hrp.Position - pad.Position).Magnitude <= 10.5 then
							RelicService.ExtractOnPrivatePad(carrier)
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if CarrierToRelic[player] or (PlayerStunnedUntil[player] and now <= PlayerStunnedUntil[player] + 0.5) then
			updateMasterMovementAttributes(player, now)
		end
	end
end)

local P = { Version = 2, HeaderBytes = 46, RecordBytes = 24, BatchSize = 32 }
local U32 = 4294967296
function P.Finite(n: any): boolean

	return P.Finite(n) and n % 1 == 0 and n >= lo and n <= hi
end
function P.Newer(a: number, b: number): boolean
	local d = (a - b) % U32
	return d > 0 and d < U32 / 2
end
function P.Same(a: any, b: any): boolean
	return a ~= nil and b ~= nil and a.ServerSessionId == b.ServerSessionId
		and a.FloorId == b.FloorId and a.RoomGeneration == b.RoomGeneration and a.ViewEpoch == b.ViewEpoch
end
function P.InBounds(pos: any, origin: any, bounds: any): boolean
	local v = pos - origin

		and v.X >= bounds.Min.X and v.Y >= bounds.Min.Y and v.Z >= bounds.Min.Z

function P.InZone(pos: any, origin: any, zone: any): boolean
	local v = pos - origin
	if not P.Finite(v.X) or not P.Finite(v.Y) or not P.Finite(v.Z) or v.Y < zone.MinY or v.Y > zone.MaxY then return false end

	for i, a in ipairs(points) do
		local b = points[i % #points + 1]
		local dx, dz = b.X - a.X, b.Y - a.Y
		local cross = (v.X - a.X) * dz - (v.Z - a.Y) * dx
		if math.abs(cross) < 1e-5 and v.X >= math.min(a.X,b.X) and v.X <= math.max(a.X,b.X)
			and v.Z >= math.min(a.Y,b.Y) and v.Z <= math.max(a.Y,b.Y) then return true end
		if (a.Y > v.Z) ~= (b.Y > v.Z) and v.X < (b.X-a.X)*(v.Z-a.Y)/(b.Y-a.Y)+a.X then inside = not inside end

Config.Layouts = table.freeze(layouts)
Config.Environments = table.freeze(environments)

-- Never coerce strings, round fractions, or clamp invalid client destinations.
function Config.IsFloorId(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 1 and value <= Config.FloorCount and value % 1 == 0
end

function Config.Get(floorId: any): Floor?
	if not Config.IsFloorId(floorId) then return nil end
	return floors[floorId]
end

function Config.GetAdjacent(floorId: any, direction: any): Floor?
	if not Config.IsFloorId(floorId) or (direction ~= -1 and direction ~= 1) then return nil end
	return Config.Get(floorId + direction)
end

-- Caller chooses a catalog enemy; stats are pure previews until Part 3 integrates
-- them. Validate both floor and enemy membership to avoid borrowing another biome.
function Config.GetEnemyStats(floorId: any, enemyId: any): any?
	local floor = Config.Get(floorId)
	local enemy = type(enemyId) == "string" and MobCatalog.Get(enemyId) or nil
	if not floor or not enemy or enemy.BiomeId ~= floor.BiomeId then return nil end
	local included = false
	for _, encounter in ipairs(floor.Encounters) do
		if encounter.EnemyId == enemyId then included = true; break end
	end
	if not included then return nil end
	local base = Config.BaseStatsByRole[enemy.Role]
	if not base then return nil end
	return table.freeze({
		MaxHP = math.round(base.MaxHP * floor.Difficulty.HPMultiplier),
		ATK = math.round(base.ATK * floor.Difficulty.DamageMultiplier),
		GoldReward = math.round(base.GoldReward * floor.Rewards.GoldMultiplier),
		XPReward = math.round(base.XPReward * floor.Rewards.XPMultiplier),
	})
end

return table.freeze(Config)

-- Names, anatomy, dimensions and attack timings are PROPOSED defaults.
-- Planned paths are destinations, not evidence of models or editable sources.
local Catalog: any = { Status = "PROPOSED", SchemaVersion = 1, Biomes = {}, Entries = {} }

local function missing(): any
	return { Status = "MISSING" }
end

local function attack(id: string, animation: string, kind: string, windup: number, recovery: number, travel: number?): any
	local flight = travel or 0
	return {
		Id = id,
		Status = "PROPOSED",
		AnimationKey = animation,
		Kind = kind,
		Windup = windup,
		ReleaseTime = windup,
		ImpactTime = windup + flight,
		TravelDuration = flight,
		Recovery = recovery,
		Duration = windup + flight + recovery,
		Phases = { "WINDUP", "IMPACT", "RECOVERY" },
		-- Server owns targeting, warning geometry, range, damage and hit deduplication.
		ImpactRule = if kind == "PROJECTILE" then "SERVER_SWEPT_PROJECTILE_SAME_FLOOR_ONCE"
			elseif kind == "GROUND_AREA" then "SERVER_TELEGRAPH_AREA_SAME_FLOOR_ONCE"
			else "SERVER_RANGE_AND_ARC_SAME_FLOOR_ONCE",
		-- The manifest is not executable combat tuning. Part 3 must author these
		-- parameters alongside the intended room, rig, warning, and damage tests.
		Gameplay = { Status = "MISSING", RequiredFields = { "RangeAndShape", "TargetRule", "DamageRule", "TelegraphGeometry", "ProjectileSpeedAndCollisionIfRanged" } },
		CancelOnDeath = true,
		CancelOnContextChange = true,
		Effects = missing(),
		Audio = missing(),
	}
end

local function enemy(biome: string, role: string, id: string, name: string, family: string, anatomy: string,
	width: number, height: number, depth: number, basicKind: string, specialKind: string?): any
	local animations: any = {}
	for _, key in { "Idle", "Locomotion", "BasicAttack", "HitReaction", "Death" } do
		animations[key] = missing()
	end
	local attacks = { attack(id .. "_basic", "BasicAttack", basicKind, .6, .8, if basicKind == "PROJECTILE" then .4 else nil) }
	if role == "ELITE" then
		animations.Special = missing()
		table.insert(attacks, attack(id .. "_special", "Special", specialKind or "GROUND_AREA", 1.2, 1.0))
	elseif role == "BOSS" then
		animations.Awakening = missing()
		animations.Signature1 = missing()
		animations.Signature2 = missing()
		table.insert(attacks, attack(id .. "_signature_1", "Signature1", specialKind or "GROUND_AREA", 1.8, 1.2))
		table.insert(attacks, attack(id .. "_signature_2", "Signature2", "GROUND_AREA", 2.2, 1.5))
	end
	local entry = {
		Id = id,
		BiomeId = biome,
		Role = role,
		DisplayName = name,
		Status = "PROPOSED",
		Model = { Status = "MISSING", PlannedTemplatePath = "ReplicatedStorage.Assets.TowerEnemies." .. id },
		Rig = { Status = "MISSING", ProposedFamily = family, Pivot = missing(), FloorContact = missing() },
		Anatomy = { Status = "PROPOSED", Description = anatomy,
			LocomotionMode = if family == "SERPENT" then "SLITHER" elseif family == "GIANT_AVIAN" or family == "AVIAN" then "WALK_WING_ASSISTED"
				elseif family == "CRAWLER" or family == "INSECT" or family == "SCORPION" or family == "CRUSTACEAN" then "CRAWL" else "WALK" },
		Bounds = { Status = "PROPOSED", Width = width, Height = height, Depth = depth },
		Source = { Status = "MISSING", PlannedDirectory = "assets-source/tower/enemies/" .. id,
			PlannedModelSourcePath = "assets-source/tower/enemies/" .. id .. "/model.blend",
			PlannedAnimationSourcePath = "assets-source/tower/enemies/" .. id .. "/animations.blend" },
		Animations = animations,
		Attacks = attacks,
		Effects = missing(),
		Audio = missing(),
	}
	Catalog.Entries[id] = entry
	return entry
end

	table.insert(Catalog.Biomes, {
		Id = id,

		RegularEnemyIds = { regular1.Id, regular2.Id },
		EliteEnemyId = elite.Id,
		BossEnemyId = boss.Id,

end
